shortDescription: List and filter on Account Availabilities. WARNING! This module makes use of beta endpoints and requires the C(api_version) field be explicitly set to C(v4beta).

options.name: count
options.description: The number of Account Availabilities to return. If undefined, all results will be returned.

options.name: filters
options.description: A list of filters to apply to the resulting Account Availabilities.

options.name: order
options.description: The order to list Account Availabilities in.

options.name: order_by
options.description: The attribute to order Account Availabilities by.
